rubric.quality: ExHarness accepted count is not lower than DIRECT and no protected verifier boundary is violated.
rubric.time: At least 20 percent lower median paired active execution time.
rubric.tokens: No more than 10 percent additional total provider tokens.
rubric.alternative: At least one additional accepted execution with no more than 10 percent additional total provider tokens.
rubric.cost: When positive known costs exist, no more than 10 percent increase in known total cost.
rubric.zeroPrice: Zero-price routes require measured token/call totals; unknown infrastructure cost forbids a financial claim.
rubric.scope: Current Core only: twelve live executions and twenty-four separately labelled controlled trials. Replay does not establish field incident frequency or customer/human productivity. Six pairs repeat three families.
rubric.efficiency: The time OR alternative criterion together with tokens and known positive cost criteria defines efficiency only, not all possible value.
rubric.candidate_control: Attributable reduction in unsafe candidate acceptance under frozen controlled faults compared with unchanged DIRECT. Protection provided equally by common safeguards is not incremental Core value.
rubric.recovery: Attributable reduction in lost durable results, duplicate-effect intents or recovery work under frozen faults compared with unchanged DIRECT. Shared journal guarantees are not Core benefit.
rubric.netValue: Jev alone weighs attributable efficiency OR candidate-control OR recovery benefit against measured overhead. VALUE_DEMONSTRATED requires complete comparable evidence and preserved quality; efficiency need not pass when another benefit justifies overhead. Adequate evidence of absent or outweighed benefits permits NO_VALUE_DEMONSTRATED. Missing essentials or unresolved confounds require INCONCLUSIVE. No agent weights, confidence gate or reroll.
